name: UEFA Euro
_comment: Hand-encoded SOURCE data (committed). First 24-team Euro. Team names use the matches-table DB spelling (Republic of Ireland / Northern Ireland / Czech Republic); the six groups were reconstructed + verified from the DB's group-stage match graph. IMPORTANT: Euro 2016 used a DIFFERENT Round-of-16 layout from Euro 2020/2024 - here the group winners that host a best-third are 1A/1B/1C/1D (third_slots 3vA/3vB/3vC/3vD), and the thirds_table below is Euro 2016's own (NOT the modern one). Verified: the four thirds actually qualified from groups B/C/E/F and thirds_table['BCEF'] reproduces the real R16 exactly (France-Ireland, Wales-Northern Ireland, Germany-Slovakia, Croatia-Portugal). Bracket labels: '1A'=winner group A, '2B'=runner-up B, '3vA'=best-third assigned to the winner of group A, 'W38'=winner of match 38. Cross-checkable against https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UEFA_Euro_2016 (Tomas's manual-verification domain). Host France's matches, like all others, are simulated neutral (documented simplification). Sanity: unfancied Portugal (3rd in group F) went on to win - an honest 'the model rated the champion low' case, expected with 1 tournament.
